about:
# Download Songs for Editor Levels

Adds the song widget from the main levels menu to the editor levels menu by way of a little button next to the song text. 
This allows you to download songs and modify them using [Jukebox](mod:fleym.nongd) without leaving the editor menu!

![mod image](supermariomastr.download-songs-for-editor-levels/mod.png)
